outcomes.intended_user_result: Budgeted recall still returns smaller relevant evidence when a stronger match cannot fit the remaining character budget.
outcomes.current_baseline: A non-fitting high-score hit increments budget omission and breaks, so later fitting authorized hits are never considered.
outcomes.acceptance: A non-fitting hit is omitted with budget accounting and recall continues to later eligible records; result order, scope, provenance, trace, max_items, max_chars, and truncation remain truthful.

excluded_scope: No ranking-policy change beyond preserving R2 score order.
No model, vector, graph, MCP, connector, external backend, or schema migration.
No change to authorization, provenance, live data, or native OMP configuration.
No remote publication without new explicit authorization for R3.

allowed_actions: create GitHub release with verified artifact

next_authorized_goal_ref: Horizon Relay after a concrete workflow is selected
